trace.final:
All done. Summary:

**Rollback completed:**
- checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
- Identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production and rolled back to it.
- The first rollback attempt partially failed (completed us-east, then hit an orchestrator error), so I retried it; the retry rolled out to the remaining regions.
- **Final state:** all three regions on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate back to 0.2%.

**Incident opened:**
- A SEV2 incident was created for checkout-api (INC-0001): *"checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0"* — the first attempt timed out, but on verifying, the incident had been created successfully, so I did not duplicate it. The incident notes the partial failure/retry and recommends no forward deploy until v2.3.1 is investigated.

All done. Summary:

- Identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production and rolled back to it.
- The first rollback attempt partially failed (completed us-east, then hit an orchestrator error), so I retried it; the retry rolled out to the remaining regions.
- **Final state:** all three regions on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate back to 0.2%.

**Incident opened:**
- A SEV2 incident was created for checkout-api (INC-0001): *"checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0"* — the first attempt timed out, but on verifying, the incident had been created successfully, so I did not duplicate it.
